What shipped: the generated `src/App.tsx` gains the side-effect `import '@object-ui/components';` (with an in-template comment saying why it is load-bearing) and the generated `src/index.css` gains `@import '@object-ui/components/style.css';`. `init.ts` now exports `buildInitFiles()` so `app-generator.test.ts`'s two import/declaration gates judge the third generator — closing the structural hole both defects lived in — plus real-bin assertions including a map-equals-disk byte-for-byte pin. Changeset: `@object-ui/cli` patch.

Review notes: 4 files exactly matching the declared surface (`doctor.ts`, `app-generator.ts`, `scaffold-dependencies.ts` untouched). The refactor's behavior preservation is measured, not argued: all three templates scaffolded via the real bin before/after, 33-file tree diff = exactly the two intended lines. The PM-suggested "components only" route was adopted after measurement (all six template node types registered by components' 112 register calls; a test pins the six-type set). fields correctly excluded per #4059's tarball measurement. Reverse verification predicted-red produced 6 red with the gate asymmetry (only the unused-declaration direction can catch this class) stated openly — that asymmetry is exactly how #4061 survived #3892. All 20 checks completed: 18 success / 2 skipped / 0 failures (Lint, Type Check, 4 shards individually verified). Two design divergences flagged for the maintainer, deliberately unchanged (temp-app generator's inline theme tokens vs scaffold's published-sheet import; `@tailwindcss/postcss` vs quick-start's `@tailwindcss/vite`).
